In front of them are several boxes of donuts with visible branding. The male character points towards the camera and gestures. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the donut boxes, showing a chocolate-covered ring donut and a chocolate mochi-style donut. The boxes feature the logos for Mister Donut and Hershey's. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the male character hands a donut to the female character, who takes a bite and smiles. They continue to interact, talking and gesturing towards the food while seated on the white table. (4) The scene cuts as they try the second donut. The female character points at the texture of the donut before taking a bite. The male character also tastes it, exhibiting an exaggerated facial expression of sweetness. (5) The final scene takes place in a kitchen. The male character is standing at the sink with his back to the camera, washing something. The female character approaches him, holding the remaining donut pieces and attempting to feed them to him while he laughs and tries to move away.
